title: Silver Plus Account: How is interest calculated and when is it paid?
summary: The document explains how interest works for the Silver Plus Account: interest is compounded daily, APY is tiered (3.0% Tier 1; 4.5% Tier 2), and setting up direct deposit adds +0.25% APY while active. Accrued interest is credited monthly.
